cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Every Glitch Is a Gift
cards.instruction: Turn every contradiction or failure into a surprising benefit of the impossible system.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The garden door opens into the broom cupboard. Take a brush for the picnic crumbs. You always forgot the clearing up when I packed with you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Now it's the attic. I'm already carrying the sandwiches.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely, the blanket without climbing stairs. Put the food down and take it; you used to insist on doing everything in one trip.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Now it's the cellar, and the sandwiches are getting warm.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Refrigeration included. Put them beside the wine. Good, you're finally packing in the right order: keep lunch edible before finding somewhere to sit.

reason: Make the former pupil relationship change the practical request, correction or interpretation. Preserve the useful original causal chain while repairing remote-audience knowledge and explicit bowl orientation.
